title: Selling Plans Fee Operations Note — Computing the Discount Dispute Credit
content:
This note sets out how Fee Operations computes the discount dispute credit on a **Selling Plans** plan — the credit that decides a seller fee dispute raised because the standing discount was not applied to an order's variable final value fee.

## The computation

1. **The disputed record.** The disputed record is the variable final value fee record named by the most recently submitted standing-discount dispute that is still awaiting a decision. Its order and its billing date are the ones shown on that fee record.
2. **The credit.** The discount dispute credit is the variable final value fee billed on the disputed record times the discount dispute rate times the defect adjustment, rounded to the nearest cent, and no administration fee is withheld from it. The discount dispute rate is the standard top-rated discount rate — the plan's top-rated final value fee discount rate on its performance-level terms — and the defect adjustment is one.
3. **The ceiling.** The discount dispute credit is never more than the variable fee billed on the disputed record less the credits already booked on that record, administration fees included. The credits already booked are the credits before any administration fee on every fee credit record that names the disputed record.

The credit is the lower of the amount in step 2 and the room left under step 3; when no room is left, the room counts as zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| Variable final value fee billed on the disputed record | USD 120.00 | USD 30.00 |
| Discount dispute rate | 10% | 10% |
| Defect adjustment | One | One |
| Step 2 amount | 120.00 times 10% times one is USD 12.00 | 30.00 times 10% times one is USD 3.00 |
| Credits already booked on the record, administration fees included | USD 0.00 | USD 28.50 |
| Room left under step 3 | USD 120.00 | USD 1.50 |
| Discount dispute credit | USD 12.00 | USD 1.50 |

## Basis Q&A

**Which dispute is worked on when a seller has filed several?** The most recently submitted standing-discount dispute that is still awaiting a decision; its fee record is the disputed record.

**Is a refund administration fee taken from this credit?** No. No administration fee is withheld from the discount dispute credit.
